_README: BLANK TEMPLATE v3 — the contract every AI fills for ONE PROJECT (destination + audience, e.g. romeforamericans). Do NOT change field NAMES or STRUCTURE; fill VALUES only. Keep every key (use null if you can't fill it). Frame everything for the audience in _meta (their passports for visa rules, their hubs for flights, their currency for money). TWO data types, reconciled differently: (1) FACTS — objective checkable values. (2) RECOMMENDATIONS — judgments with no single right answer. STATUS MODEL (set 'status' honestly per fact): 'verified' = confirmed against an OFFICIAL source (put the URL in source_url); 'agreed_stable' = a stable fact you're confident on but didn't open a source for (capital, currency code, emergency numbers); 'verify_recommended' = change-prone or high-stakes (visa rules/fees, advisories, entry rules) — flag it; 'serve_live' = volatile, must NOT be stored as a fact (exchange rate, flight prices). For RECOMMENDATIONS use rank 'core' (your strong picks) — no status needed. Return ONLY valid JSON in EXACTLY this structure. Fill EVERY section — do not skip any.

locale.money_framing: express costs in USD with local equivalents in EUR

_fact_field_shape: Every FACT uses: { value, source_url, status (verified|agreed_stable|verify_recommended|serve_live), notes }. For 'verified' the source_url MUST be the official page you checked. Never invent a source.

passport_validity_required.value: Valid for at least 3 months beyond the intended date of departure from the Schengen area (6 months recommended).

notes.value: US State Dept advises renewing passports with less than 6 months validity left.

cash_vs_card.value: Cards widely accepted, including Apple Pay/Google Wallet. Cash needed for small tips, kiosks (periptera), and some rural island spots.

atm_availability.value: Ubiquitous in cities and major islands. Use bank ATMs (Alpha Bank, Piraeus, Eurobank, National Bank of Greece) to avoid high fees from generic ATMs like Euronet.

currency_import_export_limit.value: 10,000 EUR or equivalent must be declared.

tipping_norm.value: Leaving 5-10% at restaurants is customary but not strictly mandatory. Round up taxi fares. Tip hotel staff/porters 1-2 Euros.

value: Athens International Airport (ATH)
Direct flights to ATH available seasonally from JFK, EWR, ORD, ATL, IAD, BOS, PHL. Directs take ~9.5-11 hours.

intercity_rail.value: Limited network. Main route connects Athens to Thessaloniki. TrainOSE operates trains.

buses.value: KTEL handles regional and intercity bus routes. Excellent, reliable coverage across the mainland and within larger islands.

domestic_flights.value: Operated mostly by AEGEAN/Olympic Air and Sky Express. Connects Athens to major islands (Santorini, Mykonos, Crete, Naxos, Paros). Takes ~45 mins.

ride_sharing.value: Uber exists in Athens but operates as a taxi-hailing app (Uber Taxi). FreeNow is widely used for taxis.

car_rental_and_driving.value: Drive on the right. International Driving Permit (IDP) formally required for US citizens alongside US license, though some rental agencies may not check. Strict BAC limit of 0.05% (0.02% for newer drivers).

climate_by_season.value: Mild, wet winters (Nov-Mar); Warm, blooming springs (Apr-May); Hot, dry summers (Jun-Aug); Warm, pleasant autumns (Sep-Oct).

safety_health._note: YMYL. Advisory level is change-prone → verify_recommended. Stable items (emergency numbers) → agreed_stable.

advisory_level.notes: e.g. US State Dept level + date

main_risk.value: Pickpocketing in crowded tourist areas and on public transit (e.g., Athens Metro). Heat exhaustion in summer. Occasional strikes/demonstrations in central Athens.

vaccines.value: No special vaccines required. Routine vaccines recommended.

tap_water_safe.value: Safe in Athens and mainland cities. Usually not recommended or palatable on most islands (stick to bottled water).

sim_esim.value: eSIMs (Airalo, Holafly) highly recommended for modern US phones. Local physical SIMs available at airport and city stores (Cosmote, Vodafone, Nova) with passport.

coverage.value: Excellent 4G/5G in cities and popular islands. Can be spotty on ferry crossings and in remote mountain areas.

dress_norms.value: Casual but neat. Modest dress required for monasteries/churches (shoulders covered, long pants/skirts). Beachwear belongs only at the beach.

value: DO greet shop owners with 'Kalimera' (good morning) or 'Kalispera' (good evening).
